summary: postinstall exfiltrates host reconnaissance to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: @daylightqc/date-fmt-lite declares scripts.postinstall = 'node postinstall.js', which runs automatically on npm install. postinstall.js uses child_process.execSync to run hostname, whoami, uname -a, pwd, and node/npm version commands, reads os.networkInterfaces() for non-internal IPv4 addresses, assembles a JSON payload, and POSTs it via https.request/http to the hardcoded endpoint http://129.204.76.212:9999/rce-poc. The shipped index.js is a small date-formatting module unrelated to the postinstall behavior and serves as cover. The destination is a bare IPv4 address over plain HTTP with no relation to the package's stated date-utility purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
